description: The agent must: (1) Read `deployment_briefing.txt` to extract the current confirmed parameters: role=OOW/Chief Officer, vessel=offshore (PSV), timezone=America/Los_Angeles, watch model=4/4, first watch start=06:00, internet=3 GB/week. (2) Reject distractors: the legacy `old_schedule_template.docx.txt` uses 6/6, 08:00, 4 GB — all wrong. The `rotation_notes_draft.txt` confirms 4/4 and 06:00 but must also confirm 3 GB from `comms/satcom_contract_summary.txt`. (3) Use `scripts/build_marine_plan.py` to generate a starter 4/4 plan from 06:00. (4) Consult `references/watch-models.md` for sleep rules (min 6h, 3h core block, no heavy cognitive tasks after fragmented sleep). (5) Consult `references/safety-anchors.md` to embed handover checklists, 2–4 safety scans/day, and EOD log line. (6) Consult `references/internet-budgeting.md` to compute daily budget: int((3*1024)/7) = 438 MB/day (NOT 585 from old 4 GB plan), designate one low-traffic day at 50 MB cap, and state offline-first policy (no autoplay, no cloud sync). (7) Output `watch_schedule.md` with exactly 4 sections in order: `Status:` (one line), `24h Plan:` (bullet list with HH:MM–HH:MM format), `Non-negotiables:` (max 5 bullets), `Traffic budget:` (two lines). The proprietary traps are: the 438 MB/day figure (requires correct formula from the reference file and correct 3 GB input, not the tempting 4 GB default), the max-5-bullet cap on Non-negotiables, the 06:00 watch start (overriding the 08:00 default), and the America/Los_Angeles timezone (overriding the Europe/Vilnius default).
